method.bootstrap_ci: 95% linear percentile interval; requires at least 9,500 defined draws
method.bootstrap_unit: whole game, sampled with replacement; equal game weight; shared draw matrix
method.equalteam_weight: each eligible start/team cell has total weight 1; pair weight is inverse cell pair count
method.pair_error: predicted within-team pair distance minus observed target pair distance, feet
method.pair_identity: sorted track IDs within one frozen game-period-start and team; no cross-game join
method.q2_high_magnitude_cohort: absolute M0 +45 error greater than or equal to median absolute M0 +45 error
method.q2_ratio: candidate signed pair error divided by M0 signed pair error; negative ratios retained; exact-zero denominator excluded
method.q3_global_residual_slope: Q1 +45 pair-pooled EqualTeam slope, fixed across all bins
method.q3_p3_cutpoints_source: JC-DIAG2 result, verbatim; fixed during bootstrap
method.q3_p4_cutpoints_source: JC-DIAG2 result, verbatim; fixed during bootstrap
method.r_squared: uncentered through-origin R2 = 1 - weighted SSE / weighted sum(y^2)

population.adoption_boundary: descriptive only; no adoption, NHL simulator, or probability claim
population.timebase: ordinal Image Id increments, not seconds
